HEADLINE: Pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 30 read with Schedule III Para A of Part A of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ('SEBI Listing Regulations'), ....
MORE: Pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 30 read with Schedule III Para A of Part A of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ('SEBI Listing Regulations'), please be informed that the Board of Directors of the Company based on recommendation of Audit Committee, approved the un-audited Financial Results for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. A copy of the un-audited Financial Results duly reviewed and recommended by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors, along with the Limited Review Report are enclosed herewith.
